planning_model.reading: The seven-run record has ONE run (seed48) with both Q03 and C2 failing, i.e. 1 of 7 below the 27-detector bar. The model above gives its chance as pq*pc. These are frequencies from 7 runs of one codebase family and are planning aids, not guarantees.
